title: Assessing the Reliability of Persona-Conditioned LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model-generated survey responses to human ground truth from the World Values Survey across gender subgroups using persona-conditioned prompts.
Measuring the hard and soft similarity of LLM survey responses compared to human baselines across different age groups specified in multi-attribute personas.
Evaluating survey response alignment between LLMs and human respondents across varying levels of education, employment status, occupation group, and income levels.
Assessing the fidelity of synthetic LLM survey responses to actual human data when the model is conditioned on specific religious affiliations.
Comparing LLM answers to human survey responses under persona-conditioned prompts specifying respondent ethnicity to measure subgroup fidelity and representational disparities.
